description: Default configurations the build engine applies by itself whenever it builds something (Brett, Oct 23 2026: "make the build engine check for default configurations whenever something is built like an app, plugin, or a dialog; if rules exist for particular things apply them, so the rules don't rely on Claude"). One rule = one field of one kind of thing. op `default` fills the field when it is missing; op `require` refuses the build when it is missing or not allowed. Applied by framework/cli/build-defaults.mjs (plugins.mjs --check in CI, plugin-lifecycle install, plugin-catalog pack/install, axf init, the console's plugin loader through its Python twin). Kinds and conditions are open registries: add a kind or a `when` here and in build-defaults.mjs (`CONDITIONS`), then in the Python twin (apps/console-web/server/build_defaults.py).

dialog.label: Dialog (a plugin's or app's dialog declaration)

rules.description: A plugin that renders a UI (a page or a dialog) opens it in the main application area by default. Its settings tab has the choice: main area, floating window, dialog or tab group.
A plugin without a page or a dialog has nothing to place.
Every plugin records the model that built it (plugin@1 builtWith.model), shown as a badge wherever its info shows.
Every plugin records the date it was built (YYYY-MM-DD).
A plugin isn't tabable unless it says so (plugin@1 tabable, Oct 22 2026).
A plugin includes no banner unless it lists its banner ids (plugin@1 banner, Oct 23 2026).
